mapper.select: select v.* from (select t.classify_id, t.classify_code, t.label, (select sv.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v sv where sv.CODE = 'LEASE_ITEM_LABEL' and sv.code_value = t.label) label_n, t.attribute, (select sv.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v sv where sv.CODE = 'LEASE_ITEM_ATTRIBUTE' and sv.code_value = t.attribute) attribute_n, t.attribute_value, t.superior_classify_id, (select ic.attribute_value from yx_lease_item_classify ic where ic.classify_id = t.superior_classify_id) superior_classify_id_n, t.manufacturer_id, (select m.manufacturer_name from yx_lease_item_manufacturer m where m.manufacturer_id = t.manufacturer_id) manufacturer_id_n, t.advanced_equipment_flag, t.enabled_flag, to_char(t.creation_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') create_date, t.created_by create_user_id, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = t.created_by) create_user_id_n, case when t.classify_id in (select ic.classify_id from yx_lease_item_classify ic where ic.classify_id != nvl(#{classifyId},-1) start with ic.classify_id = nvl(#{classifyId},-1) connect by ic.classify_id = prior ic.superior_classify_id) then 'Y' else 'N' end expand_flag from yx_lease_item_classify t where t.enabled_flag = 'Y') v

select ic.classify_id, ic.classify_code, ic.label, ic.attribute, ic.attribute_value, ic.superior_classify_id, ic.manufacturer_id, ic.advanced_equipment_flag, ic.enabled_flag, ic.creation_date, ic.created_by, ic.last_update_date, ic.last_updated_by from yx_lease_item_classify ic, yx_lease_item_manufacturer im where ic.manufacturer_id = im.manufacturer_id and ic.attribute_value = #{attributeValue} and im.bp_id = #{bpId} and im.enabled_flag = 'Y' and ic.enabled_flag = 'Y'

select v.* from (select t.classify_id, t.attribute_value, (select m.manufacturer_name from yx_lease_item_manufacturer m where m.manufacturer_id = t.manufacturer_id) manufacturer_id_n from yx_lease_item_classify t) v
AND v.attribute_value LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{attributeValue}),'%')
AND v.manufacturer_id_n LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{manufacturerIdN}),'%')

select decode((select count(1) from prj_project p, prj_project_lease_item pi where pi.classify_id = #{classifyId} and pi.project_id = p.project_id and nvl(p.second_hand_flag, 'NEW_LOCOMOTIVE') = 'NEW_LOCOMOTIVE' and exists(select * from con_contract cc where cc.project_id = p.project_id and cc.contract_status in('INCEPT','PENDING','TERMINATE','ET')) and p.lease_channel = '10' and p.division = 'ENGINEERING_MACHINERY' and trunc(p.creation_date) >= trunc(sysdate) - 90), 0, (select nvl(round(sum(pi.price) / count(*), 2), 0) from prj_project p, prj_project_lease_item pi where pi.classify_id in (select ic.classify_id from yx_lease_item_classify ic where ic.superior_classify_id = (select ic1.superior_classify_id from yx_lease_item_classify ic1 where ic1.classify_id = #{classifyId})) and pi.project_id = p.project_id and nvl(p.second_hand_flag, 'NEW_LOCOMOTIVE') = 'NEW_LOCOMOTIVE' and exists(select * from con_contract cc where cc.project_id = p.project_id and cc.contract_status in('INCEPT','PENDING','TERMINATE','ET')) and p.lease_channel = '10' and p.division = 'ENGINEERING_MACHINERY' and trunc(p.creation_date) >= trunc(sysdate) - 90), (select nvl(round(sum(pi.price) / count(*), 2), 0) from prj_project p, prj_project_lease_item pi where pi.classify_id = #{classifyId} and pi.project_id = p.project_id and nvl(p.second_hand_flag, 'NEW_LOCOMOTIVE') = 'NEW_LOCOMOTIVE' and exists(select * from con_contract cc where cc.project_id = p.project_id and cc.contract_status in('INCEPT','PENDING','TERMINATE','ET')) and p.lease_channel = '10' and p.division = 'ENGINEERING_MACHINERY' and trunc(p.creation_date) >= trunc(sysdate) - 90)) compare_price from dual
select ic.* from yx_lease_item_classify ic where ic.attribute = #{attribute} and ic.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' and (ic.durable_years is null or ic.residuals_rate is null)
